title: Validate a planning PNG
responsibility: Decode a complete PNG and return its dimensions within image size limits.

inputs.name: planImageCodec.bytes
inputs.description: PNG bytes, from 33 bytes through 32 MiB inclusive, with positive dimensions totaling at most 32 million pixels.

outputs.name: planImageCodec
outputs.description: Decoded image width and height after CRC-checked PNG decoding.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: invalid-image for unsupported size, invalid dimensions or failed PNG decoding.
